rubrics.justification: The morphology description largely restates the provided Gardner 2AA data accurately for ICM and TE, but no image was available and it adds temporal interpretation about Day 4 accelerated development and transfer-stage implications that cannot be verified morphologically from an image.
It thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, prior failed cycles, endometrial thickness, sperm parameters, BMI, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

The reasoning is generally logical and the probability estimate is tied to explicit adjustments, though some assumptions—especially around Day 4 blastocyst asynchrony and recurrent implantation failure framing—are somewhat speculative.

Much of the discussion is consistent with standard IVF principles, but several recommendations (ERA/ERMap, immunologic testing, intralipid/IVIG, routine steroids/aspirin, growth hormone) are not strongly guideline-supported for routine use.
It provides clear next-step suggestions for luteal support, further evaluation, and future cycle planning, but some proposed interventions are controversial or insufficiently evidence-based.
